text:
maya: FYI — Acme Financial (Evelyn) is asking for a short POC: SAML SSO + SCIM user sync + RBAC mappings. They want security questionnaire responses, hosted vs Dedicated pricing for a 3-week POC (initial 5k users), and our domain proofing approach. Timeline target: start next Tue. Any immediate blockers?

liam: On it. Quick Qs: is this IdP-initiated only or do they need SP-initiated too? ACS binding preference? Also what's the expected SCIM throughput for delta updates? We can usually demo on hosted, then move to Dedicated/Private if they need BYOK.

evelyn_acme: IdP-initiated preferred. ACS POST is fine. Scale: core directory ~120k users but initial sync 5k. Deltas ~2k/day; deprovisioning needs to be near realtime — ideally within 5m. Domain control: we must prove ownership for specific subdomains (company.acme.com).

priya: For 5m deprovision SLA we need to confirm approach — our hosted SCIM can poll deltas down to 60s but typical safe throttle is ~5 req/s. If they need guaranteed sub-5m deprovisioning we recommend either SCIM webhooks or Dedicated/Private with an on-prem agent. Also: they require groups in SAML assertions for RBAC mapping?

liam: yes we support groups->roles mapping. Example SAML attribute mapping: attributes: { "groups" -> "roles" } (we can map to multiple role rules).

liam: SCIM delta example:
```
GET /scim/v2/Users?filter=meta.lastModified gt "2026-03-15T00:00:00Z"
Authorization: Bearer <token>
If-None-Match: "etag123"
```
Use pagination + If-None-Match to avoid full dumps.

maya: Procurement asked for a ballpark: hosted POC cost (3 weeks, 5k users, light concurrency) vs Dedicated reserved node (pro-rated). Any rough numbers so I can flag to Acme?

nina: Ballpark: hosted demo + connectors ~= $1,500 flat for a short POC + metered connector usage. Dedicated single-node reserved (enterprise GPU pool) ~ $12k/month pro-rated (so ~3k for 1 week, $9k for 3 weeks) — will confirm exact SKU. This excludes any extended observability or premium SLAs. Any EU data residency or BYOK?

evelyn_acme: Data must stay in EU (eu-west). We require customer-managed keys / HSM for encryption at rest. Also need SOC2+ISO docs and a filled security questionnaire before legal signs SOW.

priya: We support KMS/HSM integrations in Dedicated/Private. Hosted supports BYOK via partner but that needs contract addendum. I will fill the security questionnaire and attach attestation docs (SOC2, ISO27001).

questionnaire-bot: New security questionnaire uploaded by priya -> https://redwood.docs/qnrs/ACME-2026 (private link)

liam: Note: EU region + BYOK => recommend Dedicated in eu-west for this POC. Hosted BYOK path is possible but longer due to legal addendum. For the demo we can run core flows in Dedicated and show a hosted fallback for feature parity (no customer data in fallback).

evelyn_acme: Can you provide an SP metadata file and a short runbook for SCIM failure modes + domain proofing steps? Our IdP team will need the metadata and expected claims.

liam: Uploaded SP metadata + short runbook: https://redwood.docs/metadata/acme-sp.xml and https://redwood.docs/runbooks/acme-scim-saml-failover.md

liam: Small metadata snippet:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://acme.redwood.example">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://acme.redwood.example/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

maya: Plan — quick alignment call Tue 10:00 CET (Acme IdP + our SE + security + bizops). Action items: liam -> SP metadata + SCIM delta example (done), priya -> finalize questionnaire + docs, nina -> send detailed pro-rated POC pricing and SOW sketch, maya -> send invite and SOW template.

nina: I'll confirm the pro-rate numbers and push a one-page POC SOW. Sending in ~2h. :thumbsup:

priya: I'm compiling answers to the questionnaire now, will attach key excerpts to the call notes.

liam: Done: metadata + runbook uploaded. ping me if the IdP needs different binding.

evelyn_acme: Perfect — thanks all. Looking forward to the call.

maya: Thanks team — I'll send the invite and keep procurement looped. :rocket:
